stausee_kreuzung_test.title: Stausee Kreuzung Test
stausee_kreuzung_test.about: Stausee near Völkermarkt: a narrow tertiary road down to a junction, a 21 m connector, then a junction where a trunk goes on as a primary and the route turns onto it (roads of different widths meeting at a junction)
spots: a dip just before the first junction (open)
the connector between the junctions, 5-8 m from the second: the roads meet at one height, no hump
the turn onto the primary (drive it at about 40 km/h)

rechberg_test.title: Rechberg Test
rechberg_test.about: Eisenkappel-Vellach (Rechberg): two short bridges close together on a narrow road, a driveway joining 2.5 m before the first
spots: the first bridge, the driveway joining before it: level across, onto the deck and off
the second bridge and the ground after its end (open: up to 5.6 G off the deck)

friedensbruecke_test.title: Friedensbruecke Test
friedensbruecke_test.about: Graz: a short bridge, then the Friedensbrücke over the Mur with the Grieskai tunnel under its west end
spots: the short bridge: onto its deck and off
the Friedensbrücke, the Grieskai tunnel under its west end

weblinger_guertel_test.title: Weblinger Guertel Test
weblinger_guertel_test.about: Graz: the route over the Triester Straße junction; under it the Weblinger Gürtel's underpass (mapped as a tunnel, twin carriageways, their portals 10 m apart)
spots: drive down to the Gürtel, 20-60 m beside the route: through the underpass both ways, its west portal

griffen_tunnel_test.title: Griffen Tunnel Test
griffen_tunnel_test.about: A2 near Griffen: a 400 m motorway tunnel, through both portals (the road in front of a portal and the tunnel's floor)
spots: the south portal: road, then the tunnel's floor, no hole, no step
the north portal: the tunnel's floor, then the road, no hole, no step

griffen_bruecke_test.title: Griffen Bruecke Test
griffen_bruecke_test.about: A2 near Griffen: out of a tunnel, then a 320 m valley bridge climbing about 4 % (a climbing deck's start, a tunnel's portal)
spots: the tunnel's portal: its floor, then the road, no hole, no step
onto the bridge: on at the road's grade, no ramp up
